title: Frontend Engineer (React)
description: Focuses on React components, lifecycle, hooks, state management, and performance.

questions.text: How do you optimize the performance of a React application with a very large list of data?
What are React Server Components and how do they differ from Server-Side Rendering (SSR)?
How does React Virtual DOM work under the hood, and what are the main benefits?
What is the purpose of React.Profiler and how do you use it to identify bottlenecks?
What are React Portals and when would you use them for modal overlays or dialog boxes?

title: Frontend Proctored (React)
description: Live video proctored interview assessing advanced React architecture, state management, and performance.

questions.text: Explain the concept of compound components in React and give a production example.
How do you optimize state transitions in React to prevent unnecessary child component re-renders?
What are some common security vulnerabilities in React applications and how do you mitigate them?
How do you handle routing and code splitting in a complex React SPA?
Can you walk me through how you would implement server-side rendering in a React application?

title: Backend Engineer (Node/Express)
description: Covers event loop, asynchronous design patterns, RESTful design, and security.

questions.text: What are the pros and cons of using GraphQL over REST for a Node.js backend?
Describe your strategy for centralized error handling and logging in a microservices architecture.
What are environment variables and why should you avoid checking them directly into source control?
How would you design a rate-limiting middleware for an Express API?
How does JWT authentication work, and how do you handle token revocation?

title: HR & Behavioral Round
description: General HR behavioral questions assessing cultural fit, conflict resolution, and leadership.

questions.text: How do you balance technical debt with the pressure to deliver new features quickly?
What is your greatest technical achievement, and what did you learn from the process?
Describe a time when you had to explain a complex technical concept to a non-technical stakeholder.
Tell me about a time you went above and beyond your standard responsibilities to help a team succeed.
How do you handle feedback or criticism from a peer code review?

title: System Architect
description: Advanced systems architecture, scaling databases, caching strategy, microservices, and high-availability designs.

questions.text: How do you ensure idempotency in a distributed payment processing system?
Design a highly-available, scalable notification system. How do you handle deduping and rate limiting?
Explain the difference between SQL and NoSQL databases. When do you use each architecture?
What is rate limiting, and what are the main algorithms used to implement it at API gateway level?
What are the main differences between event-driven architecture and request-response architecture?

title: HR Interview
description: General behavioral and cultural fit questions for any role.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you handled a difficult situation with a coworker.
Where do you see yourself in 5 years?
Tell me about a time you had to learn a completely new skill very quickly.
Why are you leaving your current role?
What is your greatest strength and your greatest weakness?

title: Java
description: Technical questions covering core Java, JVM, multithreading, and OOP.

questions.text: Explain the difference between JDK, JRE, and JVM.
How does the object serialization mechanism work in Java?
Explain the concept of multithreading in Java and how to create a thread.
Explain the difference between fail-fast and fail-safe iterators in collections.
What are Lambda expressions in Java 8 and how do they improve code readability?

title: C Programming
description: Core concepts in C including pointers, memory management, and data structures.

questions.text: Explain the difference between malloc() and calloc().
Explain the differences between a struct and a union in C.
What is a pointer to a pointer in C?
Describe how memory leaks occur in C and how to prevent them.
What are function pointers in C and what is their primary use case?

title: Python
description: Python fundamentals, data structures, decorators, and memory management.

questions.text: Explain the difference between a list and a tuple in Python.
Explain list comprehensions with an example.
How do generators work in Python and why are they memory efficient?
What is the difference between *args and **kwargs in Python function definitions?
Explain how exception handling works with try-except-finally blocks.

title: HTML
description: HTML5 features, semantics, accessibility, and DOM structure.

questions.text: Explain the difference between block and inline elements.
What are semantic HTML elements and why are they important?
How do you use meta tags for SEO and responsive display viewport configuration?
Explain the difference between local storage, session storage, and cookies.
What is the difference between HTML and XHTML?

title: CSS
description: CSS Box Model, layout models (Flexbox/Grid), animations, and responsive design.

questions.text: Explain the CSS Box Model.
Explain the difference between absolute, relative, fixed, and sticky positioning.
What is the difference between Flexbox and CSS Grid?
Explain the concept of z-index and stacking contexts in CSS.
How do you implement CSS animations and transition keyframes?

title: JavaScript
description: Core JS concepts: closures, promises, event loop, and ES6+ features.

questions.text: Explain the concept of event bubbling and event capturing.
Explain closures in JavaScript and provide an example of when to use one.
Explain the difference between let, const, and var.
What is event bubbling and how can you stop it?
What is the difference between == and ===?

title: Web Development
description: General web architecture, REST APIs, HTTP protocols, and security.

questions.text: What is DOM and how does browser render HTML pages?
Describe Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) and why it exists.
Explain the difference between WebSockets and long polling.
What is DNS and how does it resolve domain names to IP addresses?
What is a RESTful API and what are its core principles?

title: Authentication
description: OAuth, JWTs, session management, and securing web applications.

questions.text: Explain multi-factor authentication (MFA) and common implementations.
Explain how JSON Web Tokens (JWT) work.
What is single sign-on (SSO) and how does it work?
What is CSRF token validation and why is it required for secure forms?
What is Session hijacking and how do you protect against it?
